phrases.speak: Everyone talks about A I. But do you actually understand how it works? Here are eight concepts in ninety seconds.
phrases.show: Everyone talks about AI. But do you actually understand how it works? Here are eight concepts in ninety seconds.

phrases.speak: An L L M is a large language model, trained to recognize patterns in language and generate responses. It predicts text, one token at a time.
phrases.show: An LLM is a large language model trained to recognize patterns in language and generate responses. It predicts text, one token at a time.

phrases.speak: An A P I lets applications communicate with services. It's how your website can send a request to an A I model, and receive an answer.
phrases.show: An API lets applications communicate with services. It's how your website can send a request to an AI model and receive an answer.

phrases.speak: A I models process text in pieces called tokens. A token can be a word, part of a word, or punctuation. Tokens affect context limits, usage, and often A P I costs.
phrases.show: AI models process text in pieces called tokens. A token can be a word, part of a word, or punctuation. Tokens affect context limits, usage, and often API costs.

phrases.speak: Fine-tuning continues training an existing model on selected examples, helping it perform particular tasks or follow specific patterns. It changes the model itself.
phrases.show: Fine-tuning continues training an existing model on selected examples, helping it perform particular tasks or follow specific patterns. It changes the model itself.

phrases.speak: R A G lets an A I system retrieve relevant information from external sources before generating its answer. The model isn't retrained. It reads fresh passages, then answers.
phrases.show: RAG lets an AI system retrieve relevant information from external sources before generating its answer. The model isn't retrained. It reads fresh passages, then answers.

phrases.speak: Embeddings turn information into numerical vectors, helping systems compare meaning and find similar content. Similar meanings land close together.
phrases.show: Embeddings turn information into numerical vectors, helping systems compare meaning and find similar content. Similar meanings land close together.

phrases.speak: A I developers build A I-powered applications. A I engineers may also design, evaluate, deploy, and maintain the systems behind them. In practice, these roles overlap.
phrases.show: AI developers build AI-powered applications. AI engineers may also design, evaluate, deploy, and maintain the systems behind them. In practice, these roles overlap.

phrases.speak: Put them together: an app uses an A P I, sends tokens to an L L M, retrieves useful knowledge with R A G, and uses embeddings to find it. Fine-tuning is the optional path that adapts the model.
phrases.show: Put them together: an app uses an API, sends tokens to an LLM, retrieves useful knowledge with RAG, and uses embeddings to find it. Fine-tuning is the optional path that adapts the model.
